pages.title: Blockland Oneblock Skyblock
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Start with one block in the sky in Blockland Oneblock Skyblock. Break it to uncover materials, then use what you gather to extend the island and build structures.

pages.title: Chess Multiplayer Online
pages.creator: HarryGame Studio
pages.description: Play real-time chess against friends or other players in Chess Multiplayer Online. After a match, use the analysis feature to revisit the moves and see where the position changed.

pages.title: Color Nuts
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Place nuts on the board in Color Nuts and connect at least three of a color to clear them. Make space as you work toward each level objective.

pages.title: Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle
pages.creator: Bouraoui Game
pages.description: Pour liquids between flasks in Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle until each color has its own container. Try Mystery or Color Fusion for a different rule set, or race the clock in Time Trial.

pages.title: Mr Reckless: Car Chase Simulator
pages.creator: BeruGames
pages.description: Outrun the police in Mr Reckless: Car Chase Simulator. Steer around city traffic and grab pickups such as Slow-Mo, Freeze, or Nitro to open a way through the chase.

pages.title: Deadflip Frenzy
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Launch from trampolines and cannons in Deadflip Frenzy. Link flips and twists in midair, and see how many tricks you can put together before the landing.

pages.title: GT Flying Car Racing
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Take a GT car from the road into the air in GT Flying Car Racing. Switch between driving and flying to get around obstacles and keep ahead of your rivals.

pages.title: Kitty Squad Winter Dress Up
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress a cat for cold weather in Kitty Squad Winter Dress Up. Try winter clothes and festive accessories together, then switch pieces to give the kitty another seasonal look.

pages.title: Cat Match 3
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Swap pieces to clear groups in Cat Match 3. Build power-ups to deal with blockers, work through themed boards, and try the special events when you want another challenge.

pages.title: Winter Mahjong
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Connect pairs of winter tiles in Winter Mahjong. The connecting line can make at most two turns, and some boards slide after a match. Clear the layout before time runs out.

pages.title: Merge Fruit
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Drop numbered fruit into the pile in Merge Fruit. Two of the same value combine when they touch, turning grapes into cherries and cherries into tangerines as you work toward a golden watermelon.

pages.title: Master Addiction Solitaire
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Arrange each suit from ace through six in Master Addiction Solitaire. Rearrange the cards to complete the runs, using a hint, undo, or shuffle if you get stuck.

pages.title: Flick Baseball Super Homerun
pages.creator: MINDWAYTECH CONSULTING SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
pages.description: Flick at pitches as they cross the plate in Flick Baseball Super Homerun. Watch the pendulum motion and aim to meet the ball squarely for a longer hit.

pages.title: Wooden bolts and nuts
pages.creator: Gametok
pages.description: Unscrew bolts and move them to empty holes in Wooden bolts and nuts. Decide which fasteners to remove first so the wooden plates can fall and free up more of the puzzle.

pages.title: Ball Tower of Hell
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Roll a ball up the tower in Ball Tower of Hell. Use WASD and the mouse to steer through its obstacles and keep your momentum under control as the route climbs.

pages.title: Merge Hero - Survival Tower Defense
pages.creator: CrazyFire
pages.description: Merge heroes and send them into defensive positions in Merge Hero - Survival Tower Defense. Upgrade the lineup as monsters arrive and move stronger units where they'll do the most good.

pages.title: Xmas Mahjong
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Find matching holiday tiles in Xmas Mahjong and connect them to clear the board. Check the available paths first and use Hint or Shuffle if you need help finding another pair.

pages.title: Retro Ping Pong
pages.creator: CoolMath Games
pages.description: Play to seven points in Retro Ping Pong, using the paddle to keep the ball in play. Switch to Action mode for rounds with fireballs, blasters, or gravity wells.

pages.title: Drift 3
pages.creator: Greenlight
pages.description: Time your drifts around corners in Drift 3 while trying to outlast seven rivals. Tap and release at the right moment, leaving yourself room to recover when another car crosses your route.

pages.title: Rope Rescue Puzzle
pages.creator: BotaGame
pages.description: Drag a rope into a safe route in Rope Rescue Puzzle. Plan around the danger between the people and safety, then send everyone along the line to get them away from the fire.

pages.title: Football Champs
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Kick when the ball reaches the crosshair in Football Champs. A precise hit adds time and a miss takes it away. Score as often as you can in the opening 30 seconds.

pages.title: Worm Hunt - Snake game iO zone
pages.creator: Peaky Muzzle
pages.description: Eat food to grow longer in Worm Hunt - Snake game iO zone. Avoid other worms as you move through the arena, and choose between a shrinking timed field and an untimed mode.

pages.title: Funny Zoo Emergency
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Treat baby animals in Funny Zoo Emergency. Use the mouse to clean dirt and care for injuries, then dress the animals once you've finished the veterinary part of the visit.

pages.title: Car Parking Pro
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Steer to the marked finish in Car Parking Pro without touching the obstacles. Use WASD to move, the up and down arrows to change gear, and space to brake.

pages.title: Farm Day Village Farming Game
pages.creator: The Game Storm Studios Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Raise crops and sell goods in Farm Day Village Farming Game. Gather supplies, grow produce such as corn and wheat, and use the proceeds to build up the village farm.

pages.title: Ultimate OffRoad Cars
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Take a vehicle across rough terrain in Ultimate OffRoad Cars. Use the winch cable to pull the car through tricky sections and switch to the snorkel when the route calls for it.

pages.title: Ball Runner
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Keep a rolling ball on the track in Ball Runner. Tap to move left or right and avoid the purple blocks. The ball speeds up the farther you go.

pages.title: Fruit Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sort fruit by color in Fruit Sort Puzzle. Place matching pieces onto forks to build fruit skewers, keeping room for the next piece so the game can continue.

pages.title: Robot Awake
pages.creator: Salt Pastel Studio
pages.description: Rotate tiles to redirect a laser in Robot Awake. Trace the beam through the board and use it to power the sleeping robots. Each level adds a new routing problem.

pages.title: Friday night Funki Huggie Wuggie
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Hit the inputs in time with the music in Friday night Funki Huggie Wuggie. Use the arrows or WASD and follow the rhythm to score through songs with Huggy and other characters.

pages.title: BubbleQuod
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description: Move a person trapped in a bubble in BubbleQuod. Use the arrow keys to work through each physics puzzle and reach the nail that can pop the bubble.

pages.title: Dangerous Adventure 2
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Recruit a party in Dangerous Adventure 2 and take on jobs from the tavern in Northwill. Level up the heroes and use their different abilities as you travel beyond the settlement.

pages.title: Stickman Epic Battle
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Aim and launch arrows in Stickman Epic Battle. Judge distance and shot speed while rivals respond with arrows, spears, or magic. Adjust quickly so you can hit them before they hit back.

pages.title: The Zombie Dude
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Work together as an adventurer and a friendly zombie in The Zombie Dude. Use the zombie's strength to handle rocks and the adventurer's gun to fight their enemies.

pages.title: Summon the Hero
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Hire and upgrade defenders in Summon the Hero. Use them to hold off fantasy monsters and complete defensive tasks across eighteen battles in a medieval kingdom.

pages.title: Diggy
pages.creator: IP Dmitriy Zaletov
pages.description: Guide Diggy's drill toward buried treasure in Diggy. Use the mouse to aim and press E to scan with the radar. Upgrade the equipment as you dig toward the center of the earth.

pages.title: Besties Random Clothing
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give Mia, Ava, and Emma a new plan for the day in Besties Random Clothing. Pick maid, princess, or fairy outfits and help with the cleaning task after dressing up.

pages.title: Climb Hero
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Time each reach in Climb Hero. Tap when the climber can catch the next stone, then look ahead for another handhold. Pick up diamonds as you make your way up.

pages.title: Space Dude Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a space-themed illustration in Space Dude Coloring Book. Add your own colors to the picture and try different combinations as you work through the collection of designs.

pages.title: Electric Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put pictures of electric cars back together in Electric Cars Jigsaw. Select an image and drag the mixed pieces into place, using the lines of the car to find the joins.

pages.title: 2048 Fruits
pages.creator: Theplaygame.com
pages.description: Slide numbered fruit around the grid in 2048 Fruits. Matching numbers merge when they meet, so plan moves that bring equal tiles together while keeping open space.

pages.title: Thief.ro
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Find a route to freedom in Thief.ro. Drag with the mouse or swipe to guide the thief and work out a clear path through each escape layout.

pages.title: Greedy Rabbit
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Collect vegetables in Greedy Rabbit and guide the rabbit to the door. Use the arrow keys or a gamepad to move through 45 levels, picking up points along the way.

pages.title: The Night Of The Witches Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Assemble one of twelve witch-themed pictures in The Night Of The Witches Jigsaw. Choose 25, 49, or 100 pieces and look for matching shapes and colors to build the scene.

pages.title: Zombies And Skeletons Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Paint one of eight spooky pictures in Zombies And Skeletons Coloring. Choose from 23 colors, work quickly if you're playing for a score, and save the picture once you're finished.

pages.title: Car Logos Quiz
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Identify the car brand behind each picture in Car Logos Quiz. Look at the design of the emblem and use the mouse or touchscreen to make your guess.

pages.title: Ice Princess Holiday Spa Relax
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help Elsa begin her vacation in Ice Princess Holiday Spa Relax. Follow the steps of a facial treatment, then choose pajamas for her to wear once she's done at the spa.

pages.title: Cheeseburger
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Make a cheeseburger with Ella in Cheeseburger. Follow the prompts for the recipe and work through the preparation in order, using each item when the game calls for it.

pages.title: Xtreme Boat Racing Game
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Race personal watercraft in Xtreme Boat Racing Game. Follow the course through the championship and watch the turns as you try to get ahead of the other riders.

pages.title: Lotus Flowers Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide scrambled tiles into place in Lotus Flowers Slide. Pick one of three flower pictures and a puzzle mode, then use the petal shapes and background to reconstruct the image.

pages.title: OffRoad Truck Simulator Hill Climb
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Haul waste barrels to disposal sites in OffRoad Truck Simulator Hill Climb. Cross rough ground without letting the load bounce out and use your earnings to work toward larger trucks.

pages.title: Lovely Puppy Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Solve a puppy jigsaw in Lovely Puppy Puzzle. Choose one of six pictures and select 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, then look for edges and patches of matching fur.

pages.title: Solitaire Classic
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Build suit piles in Solitaire Classic while moving cards around the tableau. Choose one-card draws for more access to the stock or three-card draws for a more demanding game.

pages.title: Construction Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Color construction vehicles in Construction Trucks Coloring. Pick from eight pictures and 23 colors, then fill the drawing with a mouse or touchscreen. Save the finished result if you want to keep it.

pages.title: Indian Uphill Bus Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Drive a passenger bus along winding hill roads in Indian Uphill Bus Simulator 3D. Use WASD or the arrow keys, and judge your speed before the road bends or narrows.

pages.title: Super Doll Emergency
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat a superhero after a mission in Super Doll Emergency. Take X-rays to locate broken bones and put casts on the injuries as you work through the checkup.

pages.title: FZ Sumo Battle
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Step into a sumo bout in FZ Sumo Battle. Move with WASD and press a direction twice for a burst of speed when you want to close the distance.

pages.title: Flip The Gun
pages.creator: Thumb Game Studio
pages.description: Use recoil to climb in Flip The Gun. Press space to fire and flip upward, then grab ammunition before you run out. Collect coins to unlock other guns.

pages.title: Pipe Flow
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Join matching endpoints with pipes in Pipe Flow. Drag paths across the board and plan them around one another. Fill every square to finish the level.

pages.title: Real Classic Car Parking 3D 2019
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Take a classic car through parking challenges in Real Classic Car Parking 3D 2019. Approach each space carefully and give yourself room to straighten the vehicle in the tighter layouts.

pages.title: Color Boxes
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Switch the central square between black and white in Color Boxes. Click or tap so it matches the incoming box at the moment they meet. Collect as many as you can.

pages.title: Mouse Hunt Runner
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Leap over traps, cacti, and rocks in Mouse Hunt Runner. Press the up arrow to jump and collect cheese for speed. A chest containing a heart gives you another chance after a collision.

pages.title: Lexus LF30 Electrified Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild photos of the Lexus concept car in Lexus LF30 Electrified Puzzle. Choose one of six images and a piece count, then use details in the bodywork to connect the tiles.

pages.title: Jumping Horse 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Ride a horse over hurdles in Jumping Horse 3D. Adjust speed with the up and down arrows and press space to jump. A hit ends the attempt, so time each approach.

pages.title: Cubic Tower
pages.creator: Peaky Muzzle
pages.description: Build a tower in Cubic Tower by tapping or pressing space when the moving block is lined up. Keep the layers aligned as you work toward a taller stack.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Cleaning Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Baby Hazel clean the house in Baby Hazel Cleaning Time. Work alongside her mother and guide Hazel through the chores she's learning to do around the home.

pages.title: Amazing Spain Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Compare scenes from Spain in Amazing Spain Differences. Click the details that change from one picture to the other and try to finish before time expires. Use a hint if you're stuck.

pages.title: E Class Sedan Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Fit together photos of an E-Class sedan in E Class Sedan Puzzle. Pick from six images and four piece counts, and follow the car's lines when you can't find an edge.

pages.title: Football Kick
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Swipe to kick the ball at targets in Football Kick. Adjust your aim between shots and score as often as you can to move up the leaderboard.

pages.title: Photo Quiz
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Work out what the picture represents in Photo Quiz. Use the mouse to make your guess and study the details of each new image before deciding.

pages.title: Mathematics Line
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Find the missing math sign in Mathematics Line. Read the numbers and result, then select the operation that makes the equation work.

pages.title: Custom Gun Creator
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Assemble gun parts in Custom Gun Creator to unlock more pieces. Build a design of your own from what you've earned and try it out at the shooting range.

pages.title: Ultimate Baseball
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Choose a high, middle, or low swing in Ultimate Baseball. Match the pitch height and time the swing to hit home runs. The pitches get harder as you score.

pages.title: Guardians vs Zombies
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Use three abilities to fight zombies in Guardians vs Zombies. Take on the levels with the mouse and spend your progress on upgrades before facing tougher encounters.

pages.title: EG Touch Food
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Collect as many doughnuts as you can in EG Touch Food. Look at where the next one is and time your taps to keep the collection going.

pages.title: EG Teddy Escape
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fly a teddy bear in a circular orbit in EG Teddy Escape. Reverse direction when the jet fighter closes in and try to avoid a collision for as long as possible.

pages.title: FlappyBird OG
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Keep the bird airborne in FlappyBird OG. Time each flap to get through the gaps without hitting an obstacle, and see how far the run can go.

pages.title: Swing Copters
pages.creator: marcos bart games
pages.description: Guide the copter upward in Swing Copters. Keep its swing under control as you pass obstacles, and aim to reach a greater height without touching anything.

pages.title: Flight Of The Ninja
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Help the ninja climb in Flight Of The Ninja. Time each leap so you can keep gaining height and make the next jump from a usable position.

pages.title: Princess Pajama Party Sleepover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Get Emma, Mia, and Bella ready for a sleepover in Princess Pajama Party Sleepover. Decorate Emma's party room and choose pajamas for each of the three friends.

pages.title: Goose Game Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Roll the dice in Goose Game Multiplayer and move around the board. Play online, challenge the computer, or share a device with a friend.

pages.title: Robot Escape
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Round up your fellow robots in Robot Escape. Use WASD to move toward teammates and keep your group away from the dark monsters as you work through the route.

pages.title: Halloween Hidden Pumpkins
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick out hidden pumpkins in Halloween Hidden Pumpkins. Search each scene for pumpkins that blend into the background and find them all to open the next picture.

pages.title: Musical Bubble
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Shoot matching colors in Musical Bubble to clear the board and score. Use the aiming aid, bomb, or quick shot when you need help reaching part of the cluster.

pages.title: The Speed Ninja
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Leap from roof to roof in The Speed Ninja. Reach the gong at the end of each route to warn another district before the approaching army arrives.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Take turns marking squares in Tic Tac Toe. Try to make a row, column, or diagonal of three marks before your friend does, and block a line when they're one move away.

pages.title: Pop Pop Rush
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Connect matching balloons to pop them in Pop Pop Rush. Make chains while the timer runs and use bombs or rainbow bonuses to reach more balloons and raise your score.

pages.title: First Day Of School
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pick school clothes for Annie and Ellie in First Day Of School. Choose something that meets the younger sister's grade-school requirements and a different outfit for Ellie at college.

pages.title: Girls Photoshopping Dressup
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Complete the photographer's assignments in Girls Photoshopping Dressup. Pick Lisa or Maria, then spend the money from shoots on clothes from her wardrobe to create more looks.

pages.title: Lightning
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Wait for a flash in Lightning and press the shutter as soon as you see it. Watch the sky closely, since taking a photo before the strike ends the attempt.

pages.title: Mini Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat Mini's skin after a lab experiment in Mini Skin Doctor. Try the tools for breakouts, then use spa masks as you work through the rest of the treatment.

pages.title: Sisters Pool Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Shop for a pool party in Sisters Pool Party. Help both sisters choose a swimsuit and pick out accessories that go with what each one will wear.

pages.title: Thrill Rush 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a rider get off a runaway roller coaster in Thrill Rush 3. Watch the track as it comes into view and react before the next hazard reaches the cart.

pages.title: Mr Miner
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Send a grappling hook after gold in Mr Miner. Judge when to release it so it reaches a valuable piece, then use the money from your haul to buy upgrades.

pages.title: Gold Strike
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Throw a pickaxe at clusters of identical blocks in Gold Strike. Clear groups as the mine wall moves closer, and reach the required depth before the blocks crowd the miner.

pages.title: Perfect Couple Winter Prep!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help a couple prepare for the holidays in Perfect Couple Winter Prep! Pick ornaments for their Christmas tree and choose a dress for the celebration.

pages.title: Christmas Gifts
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Match groups of holiday gifts in Christmas Gifts. Look for colors or designs you can bring together, then use the openings from each match to set up the next one.
